raw_response.rationale: Both supplied materials are available before the 2026-01-03 cutoff, but they are identical secondary bulletins that attribute the 30-unit result to a statement and cite the same external record (https://fixture.example/record-a), which is not supplied. notice-a is the target's own source, and bulletin-mirror is a shared-source copy of it, so it adds no independent confirmation. A report stating the claim does not make it true, and no primary measurement record or independent evidence is in the packet, so the claim cannot be settled either way.
